description: The GRAPH-NATIVE investigation loop: turn a wanted ear/speech CapabilityAxis goal into an executed, measured, banked investigation WITHOUT any Python decision. mint_investigation_plan makes the PlanAct; bind_investigation_faculty is the JOIN (theme->axis->investigated_by->operator, applies_in the agent's world) that replaces the old Python _runnable_pick/operator_for_axis; the mechanical _run_investigation_reflex runs the bound faculty's executor and lays measures_axis; bank_measurement_to_axis updates the axis (saturation/shortfall) so the understand-drive's frontier RE-RANKS and SHIFTS to the next hill. Every decision is an edge or a Term; the adapter only enacts.

microtheory.name: investigation_loop
microtheory.description: want axis -> mint plan -> bind faculty (JOIN) -> run (reflex) -> measure -> bank -> shift.

rules.name: mint_investigation_plan
rules.comment: the SINGLE frontier-picked ear/speech axis (the understand-drive's top, materialized as ag-frontier_pick->ax by _frontier_advance) with no live plan -> a pending PlanAct themed on it. Keying off frontier_pick (exactly one axis) makes the frontier edge the single-active-investigation token, sidestepping the wants/satisfy churn.

rules.name: bind_investigation_faculty
rules.comment: THE JOIN: bind the act to the operator the axis names (investigated_by) AND that applies in the world the agent operates in. Replaces the Python _runnable_pick + operator_for_axis. A graph join over the shared var w, never a Python if.

rules.name: bank_measurement_to_axis
rules.comment: the measured scalar (MeasuredCapability -measures_axis-> the axis it MEASURED) updates that axis: saturation from measured/target; shortfall DECAYS; mf_stall + investigated_count increment. SINGLE-FIRES via a `banked` exclusion edge (the agent's throughput fix, ask_jabberwock_throughput): the where requires Count(m banked)==0 and the effect lays [m banked ax], destroying its own match precondition so the engine cannot re-fire through it (the loop's own bind_investigation_faculty idiom). synth_pending was NOT a single-fire guard here -- sw.execute re-stamped it on a REUSED node, so bank fired ~9x/measurement; the fix pairs this rule with record_measured_capability(fresh=True), one fresh node per trial. Decoupled from has_plan (release_executed_plan frees the plan). No decision: arithmetic over the number.

rules.name: release_executed_plan
rules.comment: release the has_plan edge once the PlanAct has RUN (its OWN status==executed, set by _run_investigation_reflex on both the success and the error path), so the axis re-mints. Keyed off the act's status, NOT the measurement (the agent's re-mint fix, ask_jabberwock_remint): escalation can move the frontier to a sibling sub-axis, but the act that ran is the act that frees its own axis -- and mint lays has_plan + theme on the SAME axis, so this back-edge always co-refers. Acts that never ran stay pending (no bound operator / no world), so release correctly refuses to free them and no pending work is lost.
